title: Ƴiiƴam Gadanal Ɓoornii ko Haayre
intro: Natal balɗe gadane neɗɗaagu, nde aduna fof wonnoo galle gooto. Aɗa ndaara no sadakeeji ɗiɗi mbaɗirtee yeeso Alla — gooto jaɓaa, goɗɗo oo jaɓaaka. Haayre ina ɓuuɓtoo e ɓernde, kulhuli ina ɓuuɓtoo e tikkere. Ko rewi heen koo maa accu daartol haa abada, hay colli tokoosi maa won jannginoowo.
clues: Mi jeyaa ko e galle gadano e dow leydi.
Mi sakkitii Alla sadak, kono am jaɓaaka tawa sadak goɗɗo oo ina jaɓaa.
Mi haali e majjere, mi hunanii ƴettude nguurndam.
Miin waɗi warngo adanngo ngo alaa nuunɗal e dow leydi.
Mi yi’i mboddi ina ƴakka leydi ngam hollude mi no ɓanndu suuɗirta.
Mi heddii miɗo heewi nimsa, mi jeyaa e majjuɓe ko juuɗe am mbaɗi.

identity.label: Hol ko ngonmi?
options: Qabil (Kayin), ɓii Aadama
Samiri, baɗɗo nagge ngee
Namruud, jom doole en luurduɗo e Ibraahiima
Azar, peewnoowo sanamuuji
Kan'an, ɓii Nuuhu gonɗo e ndiyam

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu

trial.answer: Warngo banndi mum ngam yiɗde caggal nde o salii sadak

outcome.label: Keeɓal

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
